rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=15, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-9: KNOB=wu_motion_range: 5→15 (3×, paper edge). iter-2 best SSIM 0.358 (range=5). Tested ranges 3,5,8 (≤0.358), window 1,2,3 (no gain), soft 5e-4..3e-3. Hypothesis: paper recommends ±15 for clinical helical scans; Mayo's residual motion may exceed our previous ±5 cap. Wider range at proven n_bands=6 + soft=1.5e-3 (iter-2 winner) may finally cross 0.358.
